descriptionByLocale.en:
Your responsibilities As a Young Talent in our Software Engineering team, you gain hands-on experience with modern web and .NET technologies while supporting the development, maintenance, and evolution of our applications. You work closely with experienced engineers in a collaborative and learning-oriented environment.   
• You support the development and maintenance of web applications, including the creation of new features and the enhancement of existing solutions
• You work on frontend development using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and React
• You contribute to backend development based on C# and the .NET / .NET Core framework 
• You support the development and maintenance of fat client applications based on the .NET framework 
• You assist software engineers with bug fixing, refactoring, and technical improvements 
• You support the implementation and maintenance of automated testing solutions, including unit, integration, and UI tests 
• You assist with scripting tasks (e.g. automation, build or deployment support) 
• You contribute to DevOps activities, including CI/CD pipelines, build processes, and deployment workflows 
• You participate in code reviews and learning how to apply clean code principles and best practices 
• You support incident analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging of applications 
• You contribute to technical documentation and internal knowledge sharing 
• You actively support the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and application architecture  Your profile
• You are currently pursuing or have recently completed a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field 
• You have a good foundation in software engineering principles and object-oriented programming  
• You have basic to intermediate experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem  
• You have an interest or first hands-on experience in web development, especially with HTML5 and React 
• You are interested in application development and eager to deepen your knowledge of .NET technologies 
• You are interested in automated testing, scripting, and learning DevOps practices 
• You are motivated, curious, and eager to continuously expand your technical skills  
• You are fluent in English  Our offer Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Lisa SCHNEIDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities. title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/x)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Responsibilities
• You define and execute program strategies aligned with product line objectives and business targets
• You lead and oversee multiple global sourcing and development projects, ensuring delivery across technical scope, cost, quality, and timelines
• You coordinate and motivate cross-functional teams such as engineering, sourcing, quality, or operations in a matrix organization
• You proactively identify risks and deviations, and drive mitigation plans in alignment with senior stakeholders
• You organize and lead risk and governance meetings with management and key stakeholders
• You ensure structured and transparent project reporting (KPIs, budgets, milestones) in line with PMO standards
• You manage project planning and financial tracking using tools such as MS Project
• You ensure successful project closure, including post-project follow-up (SOP +6 months) and handover to Product Management
• You drive compliance with internal processes, including the Product Engineering Process Your Profile
• You hold a degree in Engineering or a related field, combined with strong business acumen
• You bring extensive experience managing complex, cross-functional programs in an industrial and international environment
• You have solid experience in supply chain and sourcing activities, including supplier selection, cost management, and industrialization phases
• You demonstrate a proven track record delivering projects under cost, quality, and schedule constraints
• You have experience working in matrix organizations, coordinating teams without direct authority
• You possess strong stakeholder management skills and communicate effectively at all organizational levels, including senior leadership
• You have a structured, analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities
• You ideally hold a project management certification such as IPMA (Level B or equivalent), PMI, or similar
• You are fluent in English, German and/or French are a strong plus Our Offer Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us. In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email. This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent. Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER. One Passion. Many Opportunities.
